autoRules.notes: Pick a comp that can survive silences...

bosses.name: Baphomet
bosses.summary: High sustain boss with defensive stance and energy-drain mechanics.
bosses.strategyNotes: Prioritize Energy Regen on supports to counter pentacle drain. During defensive stance, save ultimates and focus on non-ult damage to drain boss energy faster. Dionysus ultimate can cleanse the silence debuff, but the 2s immunity window is short - effectiveness is RNG-dependent in auto mode. More reliable when played manually.
mechanics: Targets top DPS: grants ATK SPD but silences + self-damage

skills.name: Abyssal Sin Retribution
skills.description: Baphomet enters a defensive stance, reducing DMG taken by 66.6% and dealing DMG equal to 66.6% of ATK per sec to all targets. Energy is not deducted right away; instead loses 66.6% Energy when taking non-Ultimate DMG. Ends when Energy is depleted.

skills.name: Abyssal Annihilation Rush
skills.description: Upon entering, lays down a pentacle, increasing ATK SPD of all units and dealing % max HP damage + draining Energy every 3s. Boosts the pentacle every 25s (stacks up to 3).

skills.name: Corrupt Gift of Silence
skills.description: Infuses demonic power into the unit currently dealing the highest DMG. Target gains ATK SPD, but takes DMG per sec and is silenced for 10s.

recommendedComps.label: Meta - Tefnut Core
recommendedComps.reason: Highest damage output in the rankings - top 3 comps all use Tefnut (2.68B, 2.02B, 1.67B). Tefnut provides sustained single-target pressure ideal against Baphomet's defensive stance.
notes: Tefnut is the highest-ceiling DPS flex pick for this boss
Caishen + Dionysus + Yuelao + Isis are core - do not replace
Prioritize Energy Regen; Baphomet's pentacle drains energy every 3s

recommendedComps.label: Meta - Meret Variant
recommendedComps.reason: Most frequently seen comp overall (5/23), reaching up to 2.2B damage. Meret is more accessible than Tefnut and still performs well in the mid-to-high range.
notes: Choose this if Tefnut is unavailable or underinvested
Meret provides reliable damage without relying on warrior sustain

recommendedComps.label: Beginner
recommendedComps.reason: Accessible comp for players without Tefnut or Meret well-invested. Nuba works in the flex slot and the core four heroes are widely available at lower evolution levels.
notes: Nuba relic level 20 recommended if possible
Isis relic level 20 recommended
Core four (Dionysus, Yuelao, Caishen, Isis) are mandatory

bosses.name: Spirit of Night Hag
bosses.summary: Burst-damage boss with charge + frontal pressure, scaling via Berserk on HP loss.
bosses.strategyNotes: Position tank to absorb charge attacks. Spread formation to minimize frontal flame damage. Burst DPS early before Berserk scaling ramps up. Control/stun during charge windup to interrupt.
mechanics: Berserk: losing HP increases DEF and ATK

skills.name: Haunting Nightmare
skills.description: Summons a spectral horse to charge through all enemies dealing massive DMG.

skills.name: Soulflame
skills.description: Breathes flames, dealing massive DMG to enemies ahead.

bosses.name: Epica
bosses.summary: Control-heavy boss: repeated random-target damage + long root cage with knockback, scaling via Berserk.
bosses.strategyNotes: Shield/heal random targets during channel windows. The root from Resentment Cage cannot be removed (it is a cage, not a standard debuff). Position backline carefully to avoid knockback disruption. Fast burst to prevent Berserk scaling.
mechanics: Repeated random-target damage over time (8s channel)
Roots a random enemy for 10s + knocks back nearby units
Berserk: losing HP increases DEF and ATK

skills.name: Death Blossom
skills.description: Epica summons souls, dealing DMG equal to 40% of ATK to 2 random enemies every 0.5s for 8s.

skills.name: Resentment Cage
skills.description: Roots a random enemy for 10s and knocks back all units around it. Deals DMG equal to 100% of ATK per sec to the rooted unit.
mechanics: High single-target DoT on rooted unit

bosses.name: Lilith
bosses.summary: Summoner boss that delegates damage through spawned children. Main threat is sustained ATK SPD scaling and repeated summons; primary target is untargetable but takes shared damage.
bosses.strategyNotes: Focus damage on children first they scale with Lilith's stats but are temporary. AoE heroes shine here to clear multiple children efficiently. Sustain/healing layers critical because damage transfers to Lilith even when children absorb hits. Consider burst rotations to clear children before exponential scaling.
mechanics: Summoned children inherit % of Lilith's base/current ATK and scale HP as 600% ATK
Lilith is untargetable but takes all damage children take
ATK SPD buff on children (200%) increases outgoing damage significantly
Children respawn when all fall; scaling shifts from base→current ATK

skills.name: End of All
skills.description: Lilith enhances her children, increasing their size and ATK SPD by 200%.
mechanics: Global ATK SPD buff on all children

skills.name: Garden of Flesh
skills.description: When Lilith enters battle, she summons her children around her. They inherit 100% of her base ATK and max HP equal to 600% of her base ATK. Lilith herself is untargetable, but she takes DMG whenever her children take DMG.

skills.name: Flesh Growth
skills.description: When all of Lilith's children fall, Lilith summons them again. They inherit 60% of her current ATK and max HP equal to 600% of her current ATK.
mechanics: Children get weaker but represent multiple threat axes

recommendedComps.label: Meta - Cronus Core
recommendedComps.reason: Most frequent comp in top rankings (7/30 exact matches, dominant in top 14). Zeus clears children with AoE, Cronus adds burst windows to prevent Lilith scaling, Yuelao links both for shared stats.
notes: Zeus and Cronus should be Divine or higher for this to work
Yuelao links Zeus and Cronus for maximum stat synergy
Caishen and Dionysus are mandatory energy sustain - do not replace

recommendedComps.label: Meta - Nuwa Variant
recommendedComps.reason: Second most common top-ranking comp (4/30). Nuwa replaces Cronus for a more defensive sustain profile. Preferred when Cronus is not well-invested.
notes: Choose this over Cronus Core if your Cronus is underleveled
Nuwa provides better sustain against Lilith's ATK SPD buff windows

recommendedComps.label: Beginner
recommendedComps.reason: Viable comp without Zeus or Cronus (whale-heavy heroes). Hladgunnr provides reliable AoE DPS against Lilith children. Isis adds sustain alongside the quad-support backbone.
notes: Hladgunnr is the budget AoE DPS alternative to Zeus
Scales well without high relic investment in a single carry
Dionysus and Caishen are still mandatory

bosses.name: Isthar VI
bosses.summary: Barrier-based boss that punishes teams outside the umbrella and swings fights with knockback and large battlefield-wide bursts.
bosses.strategyNotes: Stay inside umbrella barrier for full damage output. Shield heroes critical to block knockback and AoE bursts. Use Dionysus ultimate to cleanse the ATK SPD and Move SPD slow from Sacred Ablution. Time ultimates during burst windows when umbrella protection is active. Single-target DPS vastly preferred over AoE heroes.
mechanics: Umbrella barrier: units outside deal 80% less damage
Knockback pulse; shielded units are immune
Battlefield-wide bursts; shields can negate damage
Massive AoE burst with ATK SPD/Move SPD slow; reduced damage inside umbrella

skills.name: Divine Canopy
skills.description: Opens a giant umbrella barrier at combat start. Units outside the barrier deal 80% less DMG to Isthar.

skills.name: Divine Banishment
skills.description: Knocks back surrounding enemies. Units with a shield are immune to knockback.

skills.name: Goblet of Libation
skills.description: Casts Sacred Downpour on all units, dealing burst DMG to all targets. Enemies with a shield can negate the DMG by losing their shield.

skills.name: Sacred Ablution
skills.description: Casts Sacred Ablution on all units, dealing massive DMG and reducing ATK SPD & Move SPD. Units inside the giant umbrella barrier take reduced DMG.

bosses.name: Jack Frost
bosses.summary: Zero-damage boss that progressively freezes your team and ends the battle if all units are frozen — survival and freeze immunity are the only win conditions.
bosses.strategyNotes: Jack Frost deals no damage, so healers are unnecessary. The freeze cannot be blocked or removed by any means, so prevention is critical over reaction. Until there is no other mechanic or change use best burst DPS heroes you have.
mechanics: Jack Frost deals no damage passively at any point
Targets a disliked unit and permanently freezes them as a snowman — unremovable
If all units on the field are frozen, Jack Frost leaves and the battle ends (loss)

skills.name: Tag, You're It!
skills.description: Passively, Jack Frost is merely playing around with the deities and deals no DMG.
mechanics: Boss deals zero damage throughout the entire fight

skills.name: Freeze!
skills.description: Jack Frost turns a unit he dislikes into a snowman. That unit cannot take actions. This effect cannot be blocked or removed by any means.

skills.name: So So Boring
skills.description: When all deities on the field are frozen, Jack Frost grows bored and dejected, then leaves the battlefield. The battle ends.
mechanics: Instant battle-end loss condition if all units are frozen

bosses.name: Typhoon
bosses.summary: Multi-part physical boss with fixed backline targeting, petrify mechanics, and opposing damage vulnerabilities. Splits damage across 3 independent heads (center, left, right) with the left head vulnerable to ranged attacks and the right vulnerable to melee, forcing mixed team compositions. Applies healing reduction to frontline units and threatens center backline with guaranteed petrification after repeated attacks.
bosses.strategyNotes: Position your strongest hero away from center backline to avoid focused petrification. Build a balanced team with both melee and ranged damage dealers to exploit head vulnerabilities. Tanks should absorb the AoE knockback and ultimate. Healing is less effective on frontline due to 50% heal reduction - use Dionysus ultimate to cleanse the heal reduction debuff. Focus fire on one head at a time or spread damage based on your team's melee/ranged ratio.
mechanics: Always targets center backline unit with normal attacks
Petrifies targeted unit for 2s after 5 consecutive attacks
Multi-part boss: 3 heads (center + left + right) with independent HP
Left head: +25% ranged DMG taken, -25% melee DMG taken
Right head: +25% melee DMG taken, -25% ranged DMG taken
AoE knockback zones with healing reduction debuff

skills.name: Petrifying Gaze
skills.description: Base Typhon's Normal Attacks always target the center backline enemy in the starting formation until they are defeated. After 5 consecutive attacks on the same target, he petrifies them for 2s.
mechanics: Petrify CC after 5 hits on same target

skills.name: Tempest's Lash
skills.description: Repelling Gust: Summons a storm, dealing 200% ATK as DMG to enemies within range and knocking them back 3 meters. Thunder Rage: Summons a thundercloud, dealing 100% DMG per sec to the farthest unit in front and reducing their healing received by 50% for 3s.

skills.name: Crown of Storms
skills.description: Typhon gains 2 extra heads, each taking DMG independently. Repelling Gust: The left head carries the force of hurricane. It takes 25% increased DMG from ranged attacks, but 25% reduced DMG from melee attacks. Thunder Rage: The right head holds the might of thunder. It takes 25% increased DMG from melee attacks, but 25% reduced DMG from ranged attacks.
mechanics: Left head: ranged vulnerability, melee resistance
Right head: melee vulnerability, ranged resistance

skills.name: Heaven's Endgame
skills.description: Typhon charges up, summoning a storm and thundercloud. He then swings his arms, dealing 360% DMG to all enemies and knocking them down.

recommendedComps.label: Balanced Mixed Damage
recommendedComps.reason: Balanced composition exploiting both head vulnerabilities. Ares (melee) targets right head for +25% damage, while Hladgunnr and Isis (ranged) exploit left head weakness. Dionysus provides shields to mitigate heal reduction, and Caishen sustains energy for consistent rotations.
notes: Position Ares or tank in center backline to absorb petrification
Focus left head first with ranged DPS (easier vulnerability)
Dionysus shields counter healing reduction better than raw healing
Save ultimates to burst through multi-part health pools

recommendedComps.label: Ranged Focus
recommendedComps.reason: Triple ranged DPS composition to maximize left head vulnerability (+25% damage to all main damage dealers). Cancer tanks center backline petrification while ranged DPS stays safe. Dionysus provides shields and energy sustain.
notes: Position Cancer in center backline to tank petrification
All DPS exploit left head's ranged vulnerability
Burn left head first, then focus center/right
High burst potential with 3 top-tier ranged carries

recommendedComps.label: Sustained Pressure
recommendedComps.reason: Hybrid warrior-tank in Tefnut provides melee damage against right head while surviving center backline focus. Hladgunnr exploits left head. Double support (Caishen + Yuelao) ensures energy sustain and linking buffs for prolonged multi-part fight.
notes: Tefnut can survive center backline petrification + normal attacks
Yuelao links Tefnut and Hladgunnr for shared stats
Extended fight duration benefits from energy sustain
Dionysus shields mitigate AoE knockback and ultimate

bosses.name: Nian Beast
bosses.summary: A ferocious beast lurks on the last night of the year, spreading terror wherever it goes. Its form is like a snow-cloaked mountain, its eyes burning with the dying embers of the year's end. Repeatedly cast Ultimates to startle it and cause it to retreat. Only Eastern Deities, with their divine power, can force
bosses.strategyNotes: Spam Ultimates to light fireworks - 30 fireworks ends the battle. The Nian Beast takes 10% increased DMG for every 5s in battle, so sustained fights favor you over time. Only Eastern Deities can be used.
mechanics: Cast Ultimates to light fireworks; 30 fireworks ends the battle (win condition)
Takes 10% increased DMG for every 5s in battle (ramps in your favor)
Leaps across the battlefield dealing AoE knockdown + knockback on return

skills.name: Evil-Purging Stomp
skills.description: Leaps across the battlefield, dealing 100% ATK as DMG and knocking down targets hit. Upon returning, deals 100% ATK as DMG and knocks back units hit.

skills.name: Purging Fireworks
skills.description: Each time an ally on the field casts an Ultimate, a firework is lit. After 30 fireworks are lit, the Nian Beast will flee, ending the battle.
mechanics: 30 Ultimate casts ends the battle (win condition)

skills.name: Waning Might
skills.description: The Nian Beast weakens as the night passes, taking 10% increased DMG for every 5s in battle.
mechanics: Stacking DMG vulnerability over time (favors player the longer the fight goes)

recommendedComps.label: Team A
recommendedComps.reason: Only Eastern Deities can be used. Prioritize heroes with short Ultimate cooldowns to reach 30 fireworks quickly.
notes: Only Eastern Deities are eligible for this fight
Maximize Ultimate cast frequency to light fireworks faster
Damage ramps 10% per 5s - sustained fights become easier over time
